subject: maths
title: Addition and Subtraction - Pairs and Differences

steps.title: Find the missing partner

options.label: Seven spaces are filled. Add counters until the ten frame is full.
How many forward jumps take you from five to nine?
Ten beans are ready. Hide four by taking them off the tray. How many stay visible?

steps.hint: Count the empty spaces. Each needs one counter.
steps.explanation: Make ten and count the difference as jumps.
steps.shortExplanation: Make, count or compare the objects. Explain what changed.

mathWorkshop.title: Find the missing partner
mathWorkshop.goal: Make ten and count the difference as jumps.

tasks.prompt: Seven spaces are filled. Add counters until the ten frame is full.
tasks.feedback: You added three counters. Seven and three make ten.
tasks.hint: Count the empty spaces. Each needs one counter.

tasks.prompt: How many forward jumps take you from five to nine?
tasks.feedback: Five to nine takes four jumps. The standing start is not a jump.
tasks.hint: Start on five. Count jumps to six, seven, eight and nine.

tasks.prompt: Ten beans are ready. Hide four by taking them off the tray. How many stay visible?
tasks.feedback: Six are visible and four are hidden. Both parts still make ten.
tasks.hint: Remove four beans. Count only those still on the tray.

parentReview.en: Guided practice is ungraded. Completion records the child doing the activities, not a book-question score.

steps.title: Partners of 10
steps.hint: Use a ten frame: how many spaces are still empty?
steps.explanation: The partners are 6 and 4, 2 and 8, 5 and 5.
steps.shortExplanation: The partners are 6 and 4, 2 and 8, 5 and 5.

steps.title: Empty spaces
steps.hint: Fill 7 spaces, then count the empty ones.
steps.explanation: Seven filled spaces leave 3 empty spaces in a ten frame.
steps.shortExplanation: Seven filled spaces leave 3 empty spaces in a ten frame.

steps.title: The same total
steps.hint: Count on from the bigger number in each sum.
steps.explanation: Both addition sentences have the same total: 5.
steps.shortExplanation: Both addition sentences have the same total: 5.

steps.title: Adding on a line
steps.hint: Start on 12 and make three jumps forward.
steps.explanation: Three forward jumps from 12 land on 15.
steps.shortExplanation: Three forward jumps from 12 land on 15.

steps.title: Taking away 4
steps.prompt: There are 16 cubes. Take away 4. How many remain?
steps.hint: Count 16 cubes, cover 4, then count the cubes left.

steps.title: Difference of 5 and 9
steps.prompt: What is the difference between 5 and 9?
steps.hint: Start on 5 and count the jumps to 9.

steps.title: A sensible total
steps.prompt: Sam says 6 + 3 = 19. Choose the sensible total.
steps.hint: Is 6 + 3 small or big? Could it be near 20?
steps.explanation: Six and three are small groups. Together they make 9.
steps.shortExplanation: Six and three are small groups. Together they make 9.

source.answerKeyText: No. Both numbers are small, so the answer can't be near 20. 6 + 3 = 9.

steps.title: Hidden beans
steps.prompt: There are 10 beans. You see 6. How many are hiding?
steps.explanation: Six visible beans and 4 hidden beans make 10.
steps.shortExplanation: Six visible beans and 4 hidden beans make 10.

steps.title: Making 10
steps.hint: Check each pair on a ten frame.
steps.explanation: 6 and 4 fill all ten spaces of a ten frame.
steps.shortExplanation: 6 and 4 fill all ten spaces of a ten frame.

steps.title: Difference of 8 and 10
steps.hint: Start on 8 and count the jumps to 10.
steps.explanation: Two jumps go from 8 to 10, so the difference is 2.
steps.shortExplanation: Two jumps go from 8 to 10, so the difference is 2.

steps.title: Adding 2 to 14
steps.hint: Start on 14 and jump forward twice.
steps.explanation: Two jumps forward from 14 land on 16.
steps.shortExplanation: Two jumps forward from 14 land on 16.

steps.title: Taking 3 from 18
steps.hint: Start on 18 and jump back three times.
steps.explanation: Three jumps back from 18 land on 15.
steps.shortExplanation: Three jumps back from 18 land on 15.

stickers.meaning: How many steps from the smaller number to the bigger number.

homeActivities.text: Use ten safe large counters. Hide some under a cup, count what remains and find the hidden partner. Use a number track for differences.
homeActivities.textAr: استخدموا ١٠ حتت كبيرة وآمنة. خبّوا شوية تحت كوباية، عدّوا اللي باقي، وخمّنوا كام مستخبي. واستخدموا شريط أرقام عشان تلاقوا الفرق بين رقمين.
homeActivities.safety: An adult supervises. Keep small objects away from younger children. An adult handles scissors. Use water at the sink, away from electrical items.
homeActivities.safetyAr: لازم شخص كبير يكون موجود. خلّي الحاجات الصغيرة بعيد عن الأطفال الأصغر، والكبير يمسك المقص. أنشطة المية تكون عند الحوض وبعيد عن الكهرباء.
